Lady Gaga has reportedly welcomed her first child with her fiancé, Michael Polansky, marking a major new chapter in the singer's personal life.

PEOPLE reported on September 12, 2026, that Gaga has become a mother, with sources confirming the arrival of her first baby with Polansky. Vogue also reported that the couple had welcomed their first child, while noting that the baby's name and sex had not been publicly disclosed.

The news comes after years of Gaga speaking openly about her hopes of becoming a mother. She has discussed wanting children in interviews throughout her career and has described motherhood as an important personal dream.

A Dream of Motherhood

Motherhood has been something Gaga has talked about for many years.

In previous interviews, the singer spoke about wanting a family and having children. Her hopes became especially notable as her relationship with Michael Polansky developed.

In a 2024 Vogue interview, Gaga discussed family, love, and her relationship with Polansky. She also acknowledged that having children was something she had wanted for a long time.

The arrival of her first child now represents the beginning of a chapter she has openly imagined for years.

A Relationship Built Away From the Spotlight

Gaga and Michael Polansky began their relationship around 2019 and became publicly known as a couple in 2020.

Their relationship became stronger during the COVID-19 pandemic, when they spent an extended period together in Malibu. Gaga later described that time as an opportunity to focus on her relationship and get to know Polansky away from the pressures of her career.

Polansky has generally maintained a lower public profile than Gaga. The couple became engaged in 2024, and they have continued to keep many aspects of their personal life private.

A New Chapter for Lady Gaga

For much of her career, Gaga has lived in front of millions of people around the world.

Her career has included major music releases, Grammy Awards, acting roles, international tours, and some of the most recognizable performances in modern pop culture.

Motherhood brings a different kind of chapter. Instead of focusing only on stages, recording studios, and film sets, Gaga now begins a new journey centered around family.

Fans Celebrate the News

The reported arrival of Gaga and Polansky's first child quickly attracted attention from fans and entertainment audiences around the world.

Gaga has long been known affectionately by her fans as Mother Monster, but the nickname now has an especially personal meaning as she begins motherhood herself.

While fans are celebrating the news, important details about the baby have remained private.

Respecting the Family's Privacy

Reports have confirmed the arrival of the couple's first child, but the baby's name and sex have not been publicly disclosed in the latest reports.

Gaga's representatives had not publicly commented at the time of PEOPLE's initial report.

For a celebrity whose professional life has been intensely public, this moment offers an opportunity for Gaga and Polansky to experience an important family milestone away from unnecessary attention.

A Meaningful New Beginning

Lady Gaga's journey into motherhood marks one of the most personal chapters of her life.

After years of building a remarkable career and openly discussing her hopes for a family, she and Michael Polansky are now beginning life as parents.

For Gaga, the next chapter may look very different from the stages and red carpets that have defined much of her career. For her fans, the news offers another reason to celebrate an artist entering a deeply personal new season of life.
